'''1997 Kiffex Regionals''' was a Decipher-era constructed event. Published lists from this event are the 60s Decipher posted on Deck Designs.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Dates:''' August 1997
